Sara supporting Castro Valley Pride
|
As your Hayward Area Recreation and Park District (HARD) Director, I work to ensure equity and access across the district so that everyone has the safe and joy-filled recreation opportunities that meet their needs and interests.
From the first shuffle of my tap shoes at age 5 to my certification as a Laughter Leader 25 years later, I have done my best to infuse recreation into my life and the lives of others.
During my 20 years as a state and nationally certified recreation therapist, I developed and ran a wide variety of programs for thousands of people of diverse ages, abilities, and life experiences. Those same planning and people skills have made me an effective policymaker. During the 8 years I served as a Hayward City Council Member (2 of those years as Mayor pro tem), I led efforts to ensure sound management of tax dollars, environmental sustainability, decreased homelessness, and increased transparency and public participation in local government.
Now, as President of the HARD Board, I look back on my first term as a HARD Director and am grateful each day to be part of such a remarkable organization. As such, it is my fervent desire to be re-elected in 2026 and continue to support the vibrant community I have known, lived in, and love. Please help by voting for me on Tuesday, November 3rd, 2026.
Visit my social media account and that of HARD to keep up with all the news or contact me via the form below. I look forward to seeing you at an upcoming community event and to hearing your thoughts about HARD.
Until then, hope you and yours are well.
## Contact Sara
Have any questions, comments, or concerns? Write Sara!
